label: Diagram 4.2
caption: Diagram 4.2 Type B, elevation view showing minimum dimensions
description: This is an elevation view, captioned at the bottom "Diagram 4.2 Type B, elevation view showing minimum dimensions". It shows a wall with a toilet pan at lower left, a recessed shelf above it, a rectangular mirror over a basin counter in the centre, and two wall hooks on the right. A small box marked "HD" sits on the wall between the shelf and the mirror; a legend at right reads "HD Hand-drying facility". Labels read "Mirror", "High hook", "Low hook", "Position of shelf". Below the counter a dashed arc indicates the basin. Vertical green dimension lines give, from the floor: "780–800mm" to the top of the shelf; "780–800mm" to the counter surface; "1780mm" to the top of the mirror; "1050mm" to the low hook; and "1685mm" to the high hook. A horizontal green dimension at the bottom, spanning the width between the two walls, reads "1685mm". Two NOTES at right follow, referring to Appendix D and the concealed toilet cistern.
